purpose: Design of the agent-review backend: a read-only reviewer custom Agent, an availability-check-only SKILL, its constraints, stateless operation, and test design.

Result format with available, missing items (axis, detail, remedy), and retains_context
retains_context is always false, matching the resolve_review_backend.py declaration
State and resource policy: no sessions, transcripts, history, DB records, or daemons
